title: Terms and Conditions
p1_title: No Substitute for Official Land Registration
p1: The Nila land title is a digital asset and does not serve as a cadastral registration or legal documentation of land ownership as recognized by national administrative or governmental offices.
p2: Holding a Nila land title does not provide ownership rights, claims, or control over the physical land associated with the title. These titles are solely a representation of digital rights to exchange and market the land title on Nila-affiliated blockchains.
p3: Nila land titles are bound to the wallet of the verified landowner and cannot be transferred, sold, or sent to other wallet addresses. Ownership of the digital title must remain with the rightful landowner.
p4: Landowners have the right to mint a new token for their land, which will render any previously issued NILA land title token invalid and without value. The process of minting a new token is at the sole discretion of the landowner.
last: By holding a Nila land title, you agree to these terms and acknowledge the nature and limitations of the asset as outlined above.
